newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's job market still need changes - BoS.
newsitem.headline: Spain's job market still need changes - BoS.

text.p: Spain's central bank governor Luis Angel Rojo on Tuesday praised recent efforts to reform the labour market, but said more changes were needed to boost jobs.
"The job market is one of the areas which needs more changes, as the low level of employment and the high level of unemployment prove," Rojo said in the Bank of Spain's yearly report.
Rojo said the pact reached between unions and employers was a step in the right direction.
"The pact agreed by employees and unions is an unquestionable advance for a gradual change in the Spanish labour market," Rojo said.
But he added that for the reforms to work, more flexibility was needed.
"But we also need more flexibility in the goods and services market, without which the pact's positive effects will not impact on the level of employment," he said.
